sentences.text: Researchers used high-resolution imaging methods to compare the structure of inhibitory synapses located on the cell body versus those on the dendrites.

While dendritic synapses typically have a compact shape with receptor clusters organized into aligned columns, synapses on the cell body were found to be larger and possess a more varied and complex structure.
Specifically, cell body synapses displayed a wider variety of structures, including both aligned columns and disorganized arrangements where release sites and receptors did not line up.
Computer simulations suggested that these structural differences lead to stronger electrical signals and different timing properties at cell body synapses.
